summary: Re-tested SQZ catalog after redesign to dark editorial luxury (Zara/Spider-Man hybrid). Backend /api/health passes 3/3 tests. Frontend Home + Produtos pages fully functional, NO emojis anywhere, all data-testids present, 36/36 products + images loading, all 6 filter buttons working with correct counts, navigation between pages working, custom cursor in DOM, lemon SVG animation present, marquees scrolling, sobre/featured sections render, footer with editorial SQZ logotype + 'squiiz by Lemon Jelly' branding.
critical_code_review_comments: Emoji audit: rendered innerText scan via Unicode emoji block regex returned 0 matches on both / and /produtos. Explicit checks for 🍋 ⭐ 👈 👉 ▶ ✨ 🎯 🔥 💎 🌟 also clean. Redesign successfully removed all emojis per user requirement.
Home.jsx is 340 lines — slightly large but cohesive; below the 700-line threshold so no split needed yet.

Framer-motion useScroll warning in console: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position'. Cosmetic only — parallax still works. Optional fix: ensure heroRef container has position: relative (it already has 'relative' class so this is likely from an internal mount race; non-blocking).
React Router v7 future flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) — informational only, opt-in for v7 readiness.
Backend has CORS allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — spec-incorrect combination; harmless for public catalog but worth tightening for production.
ProductCard images use loading='lazy' and recover correctly after fast scroll (verified 36/36 loaded, 0 broken).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend = single /api/health endpoint (3 pytest tests pass). Frontend redesign verified: dark editorial cinematic look at viewport 1920x1080. Verified data-testids: app-root, navbar, home-page, hero, hero-title (text='SQZ'), hero-slogan ('When life gives you lemon...'), hero-cta-produtos, hero-cta-sobre, lemon-squeeze-anim, lemon-section, sobre-section, featured-section, featured-view-all, marquee (x2), cta-explorar, produtos-page, produtos-title ('Coleção SQZ'), filter-bar, filter-button-{all,colares,brincos,aneis,capas,acessorios}, products-grid, empty-state. Filter counts: all=36, colares=11, brincos=10, aneis=5, capas=5, acessorios=5. Custom cursor (cursor-dot + cursor-ring divs) rendered. Lenis smooth scroll active — use window.scrollTo or page.evaluate for scroll. Allow ~3-4s after navigating to /produtos for the 36 large PNGs to load. Console has framer-motion warning + react-router v7 future flag warnings — both cosmetic.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Redesign meets all spec requirements: dark cinematic luxury, no emojis, custom cursor, parallax hero, scroll reveals, 36 products with filters, professional editorial typography (Instrument Serif + Manrope).
